talk.transcript: Today, we're going to discuss the concept of 'cognitive dissonance.' This psychological theory explains the discomfort we feel when holding conflicting beliefs or attitudes. For instance, if someone values healthy eating but regularly eats junk food, they might experience cognitive dissonance. This discomfort often motivates individuals to change their beliefs or behaviors to restore harmony. It can lead to various outcomes, such as justifying their actions, changing their eating habits, or even altering their beliefs about health. Understanding cognitive dissonance helps us comprehend how we make decisions and rationalize our behavior in daily life.

questions.explain: 認知失調是心理衝突的一種。

questions.q: What might someone do when feeling cognitive dissonance?
questions.explain: 感受到認知失調時，人們可能會忽視衝突、改變信念等。
衝突的信念會觸發認知失調。

questions.q: Why is understanding cognitive dissonance important?
questions.explain: 理解認知失調有助於理解決策過程。
